CONSTRUCTION ISSUE — subject to site survey & local engineer sign-off
Construction drawing set — Design A (as client renders): timber-soffit steel canopy, raised planter, 3-tone paving, lattice joinery
AXONOMETRIC VIEW FROM SOUTH-EAST (east wall & screen shown cut away at 1.0 m) — NTS
Cover sheet, drawing register & project information
Paving layout, levels & surface water drainage plan 1:50
Canopy roof plan — falls, gutter & membrane 1:25
Section C-C planter; slot drain, gully & edge details 1:10
Details 1 — post base, corner, eave & façade junction
Details 2 — LED, soffit, back-span, fascia & wires
Structural design basis, loads & member checks
• Canopy: 4.85 x 3.15 m flat steel canopy, 370 mm white aluminium fascia, thermo-ash slatted soffit with perimeter warm-white LED, membrane roof draining through post P1.

• Structure: galvanised steel frame (UPN ledger, RHS beams, lipped-C joists) on 2 timber-clad posts; east corner by cantilever S1 (as render) or post P3 S2 (recommended where existing structure is unverified).
• Planter: 8.4 m long x 1.0 m raised RC planter, rendered, precast coping, drip irrigation, star jasmine & Mediterranean shrubs, 6 uplights.
• Paving: 52.1 m² 200x200 concrete pavers in 3 tones, cross-falls to 2 gullies + threshold slot drain.
• Joinery: glazed alu door D01, roller shutter D02, timber lattice door D03, lattice screen & gate G01.

Issued for construction / tender, subject to: (1) measured & level survey, (2) structural engineer's design & sign-off, (3) any planning/building permit required locally, (4) utility survey before digging.
